ns2:course.label: Teach Elem Rdg & Lang Arts, II
ns2:course.description: Course examines the basic theories, issues, methods, and materials for a developmental K-8 language arts program. Emphasizes language arts (including reading, as well as writing, speaking, and listening) as tools for learning across the curriculum. Addresses cultural diversity in language arts instruction, with emphasis on linguistic diversity. Prerequisite: CI 467 and CI 475; admission to the Elementary Teacher Education Program.
